Now investigating a defect I found in the counter's tcp6 mask — it compares 16-hex constants against a 32-hex field, so IPv6 loopback (`::1`) is counted as egress. Testing reachability.Now checking reachability of the IPv6 mask defect in the counter's real live leg — first inspecting the counter's entry/receipt inputs and measure.sh.Now checking whether the counter's live leg can be exercised read-only (to test my mask finding against the real instrument).Now testing whether the counter's TCP-ESTABLISHED-only view is complete — checking UDP/QUIC egress that a TCP-only sampler would miss.Now checking whether the frozen counter itself can be run read-only against the lane repo (no checkout) for a comparison leg.Both variants reproduce. Let me check the counter's teardown/coverage and compare with sibling seat report conventions.Decisive finding confirmed. Now verifying my proposed correction against ground truth.Decisive finding. Let me run the counter at the freeze commit too and stage all evidence.Now verifying the counter is unchanged at the w1 landing, and consolidating all evidence.All evidence gathered. Running a final precise timing measurement and consolidating.Both legs reproduce.
